book.name: 2 TIMOTIUS
book.title: SURANA PAUL TO RUA MPEARONA TO TIMOTIUS

content: Kakembana to Timotius to Aoseaka Anamisi Kanarakaa Mboomo Isa Al Masi
E anaku Timotius, pekatangkamo karomu minaaka i rahumati modhaangiana i nuncana Isa Al Masi,
tee opea mopadhana ipogauakaku i aroana bhari sakusii, upakawaakea tee uadhariakea i manga umane momembalina iparacaea tee manga mia incia sumai amembali aadhariakea uka i mia mosagaanana.
Mboomo samia suludaduna Isa Al Masi momalape, mboo sumai uka ingkoo tabeana upotaangi utanggo kanarakaa.
Samia suludadu motangasaana motugasi inda bheapekangule karona tee urusana dhadhina saesaeo, roonamo incia gauna apasanaa kapalana.
Mia moosena kagasia pologoa inda bheapotibhaaka juara ande inda aose tutura modhaangiana i nuncana kagasia sumai.
Samia pande poinawu ande apadhamo amanguleaka penembulana incia alaenga amembali mia mobhaa-bhaana moniʼimatina hasilina penembulana.
Udhania o pogauku sii, roonamo Kawasana Opu bheadhawuakako kapooli to umaʼanaiaka bhari-bharia giu incia sumai.
Udhanimea o Isa Al Masi mominaakana i siwuluna Nabii Daud tee motopadhadhina pendua minaaka i mate; siitumo Lele Malape ipakawaakaku.
Rampaakanamo Lele Malapemo sumai iaku kutanggo kanarakaa sakawana kutotorongku mboomo parampo, maka inda dhaangia momembalina motorongkuna firimanina Aulataʼala.

Rampaakanamo sumai, iaku kurela kutanggo bhari-bharia giu incia sumai to manga mia ipilina Aulataʼala mamudhaakana manga incia uka apotibhaaka kasalaamati i nuncana sarona Al Masi tee kamuliangi mobakaa.
Atotuumo pogau incia sii,

content.text: sumaimo ingkita bhetadhadhi tapobhawa tee Incia.
Ande ingkita tarela tatanggo bhari-bharia giu incia sumai,
ingkita uka bhetapoose tauncura i nuncana pamarintana.
Ande ingkita inda takeniaka janjita tee Incia,
Incia sadhaadhaa akeniakea o janjina, roonamo Incia inda amembali apesapuaka karona."

content: Kaadhari Wakutuuna Tapoaroaka Guru Mosaladhala

Bhari-bharia giu incia sumai tabeana utorotorosu uudhaniakea tee usameaakea i manga mia i aroana Kawasana Opu mamudhaakana inda apotagatagaliaka maʼanana pogau inda mokoguna, roonamo giu incia sumai inda akoampadhea, maka soo apahancuru dhadhina manga mia morangoa.

Usahaakea tee mpuu-mpuuna incamu mamudhaakana o Aulataʼala aʼakuiko umembali mia molaengana mopakawaakana firimanina tee bholi unamisi kaea tee opea ikarajaamu sumai tee atotuu-totuu uadhariaka kabanara.
Bholi uperangoi manga bhoasaka inda mokoanto mofikiriakana dunia tee momembalina mopasaladhalana mia, roonamo manga bhoasakamo mboo sumai imembaliakana mia soo ahanda o kadhakina.
Naile itu o kaadharina manga incia sumai bhemomembalina mboomo panyaki mopekalalemi mopesuana i nuncana badata. Himeneus tee Filetus motolentuna manga mia mboo sumai.
Rua miaia aose dhala mosaladhala tee aadhariaka ande ingkita inda bhetatopadhadhi pendua sapadhana tamate. I fikirina manga incia, saangu-anguna kalalesa tatopadhadhi pendua amembalimo.
Tee kaadhari incia sumai, manga incia padhamo apewau sagaa minaaka i witinaita saʼagama abholi kayaakinina tee Al Masi.

Maka o fondasi momatangka mopadhana idhikana Aulataʼala inda bheakohudha, tee i bhawona atoburi mboo sii, "Kawasana Opu amataua o pewauana," tee uka, "Incema moʼakuina ande o karona o mia moosena Kawasana Opu, incia tabeana apekaridhoa o karona minaaka i giu madhaki."

I nuncana saangu bhanua momaoge dhaangia tee pegiu-giuna kamondona parakakasi, mencuana tangkanamo parakakasi motokarajaana minaaka i bulawa tee pera, maka dhaangia uka motokarajaana minaaka i kau tee minaaka i tana reo. Dhaangia motopakena to karajaa momulia, tee dhaangia uka motopakena to karajaa inda momulia.

Mboo sumai uka tee manga giuna maanusia. Ande o mia apekangkilo karona minaaka i giu madhaki, sumaimo incia bheamembali parakakasi to tujua momulia. Incia atopekangkilo, tee alaenga apakea opuna, tee incia atopasiapuaka tee atopake i bhari-bharia karajaa momalape.

Rampaakanamo sumai, pekaridhoa o karomu minaaka i sagala giu nawusuuna manga mia mangura, tee uose kabanara, iimani, umaasiaka maanusia rangamu, tee udhadhi upomalape. Dhadhimo mboo sumai upobhawa-bhawa tee manga mia moemanina tulungi i Kawasana Opu tee ngangaranda momangkilo.
Pekaridhoa o karomu minaaka i potagatagalina manga mia mokabhongo-bhongo inda momatauna opeopea, roonamo umataua bhari-bharia giu incia sumai tangkanamo bheaumbaaka pogera-gera,
sainamo bhatuana Kawasana Opu inda alaenga apogera-gera. Incia tabeana amalape o pewauna tee bhari-bharia mia, incia tabeana amembali guru to mia mosagaanana, tee tabeana asabara,
tee amalulu o bhoasakana pogauna wakutuuna aadhari mia momentagali mamudhaakana o Aulataʼala adhawuakea rahumati to manga mia incia sumai to atobaaka minaaka i dosana tee amatauaka kaadhari mobanara,
tee mboo sumai manga incia amembali asadara pendua, tee atorambasaka minaaka i kabhokena katapu imembaliakana manga incia aose kapeeluana Ibilisi.

footnotes.text: saangu-anguna kalalesa tatopadhadhi pendua amembalimo: Sii-sii o dasarana to kaadhari gau-gau sii inda atomatau, maka akera-keraia inda amaridho o posalana minaaka i kaadhari mosaladhala ibhalina Paul i nuncana sura 1Kor. 15:12-19.
